title: Screenshot comparison upload
responsibility: Submits before-and-after screenshots and their comparison details to a report.

inputs.name: UploadComparison.reportId
inputs.description: Required report identifier included in the upload body.

inputs.name: UploadComparison.onUploaded
inputs.description: Required callback receiving the successful response cast as a Report.

outputs.name: UploadComparison
outputs.description: Expandable form with required title up to 120 characters, optional viewport and two required PNG, JPEG or WebP file selections. Posts form data, displays progress or failure, and resets fields and file labels after success. Submission is disabled before mount or during upload.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Non-success HTTP responses raise the returned error or Upload failed inside the submit handler. The handler catches errors and renders their message rather than exposing them to the caller.
